title: Official blog knowledge stage 6
summary: This iteration adds an internal intake queue for OpenAI and Anthropic official blog previews. Local candidate previews can now be triaged with the Stage 5 admission policy, deduplicated against curated official blog knowledge, and written through clean CLI JSON output while rejecting public docs/data, official-blog page, and public HTML output paths.

lessons.lesson: Official blog ingestion should create an internal review queue before it creates public knowledge records.
lessons.evidence: Stage 6 writes `official_blog_intake_queue` output with `visibility:"internal"`, review candidates, exclusions, duplicates, and invalid candidates while refusing public `docs/data`, `docs/official-blogs`, and public HTML output paths.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep crawler and manual preview ingestion pointed at the internal queue until a human or a later audited step drafts curated knowledge records.

lessons.lesson: Opening-preview triage needs a stable interface independent from live fetching.
lessons.evidence: `official-blog:intake --input --output` accepts local candidate previews and runs deterministic triage without network access, so crawler output can be tested before live RSS/page fetching is added.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding live fetching, write the crawler result into the same local preview shape and keep tests network-free.

lessons.lesson: Deduplication must happen before review work is created.
lessons.evidence: Stage 6 reports existing curated knowledge URL duplicates and same-batch duplicates separately, preventing repeated translation or summary work for already known blog posts.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep normalized URL matching as the first intake dedupe key and only add fuzzy title matching after separate review.

suggestions.issue: New official blog previews had no internal queue between discovery and curated public knowledge records.
suggestions.evidence: Stage 6 adds `createOfficialBlogIntakeQueue`, CLI command `official-blog:intake`, deterministic tests for include/review/exclude/duplicate cases, public-output path rejection, controlled new-product matching, and clean `--output` JSON behavior.
suggestions.suggestion: Use an internal review queue as the stable handoff between future OpenAI/Anthropic blog discovery and curated knowledge-record authoring.
suggestions.expected_benefit: New product, model, harness, agent workflow, eval, safety, and implementation-practice posts can be tracked without letting generic partnerships or internal triage diagnostics leak into public pages.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented through deterministic intake tests, CLI output tests, and repository validation.
validation_evidence: official blog intake creates an internal review queue from opening previews
official blog intake CLI writes a clean internal review queue
official blog intake CLI refuses public output paths

followups.action: Add a non-network fixture-backed official blog feed parser that converts OpenAI and Anthropic RSS/index entries into the Stage 6 preview input shape.
Add a reviewed authoring step that turns selected `include` queue entries into curated `knowledge/official-blogs/**` records with Chinese summaries and source links.
